name: Hamaji
source:
The protagonist and [url=/c42248]Sousuke's[/url] childhood friend.
He's the son of the mayor of their village.
Along with Sousuke he is also quite protective of the protagonist.
He's quite popular with women and is always rejecting marriage proposals.
